preconditions.description: The input integer n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The input consists of a single integer n.

postconditions.description: If n is less than 4, the output is exactly 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: n >= 4 and stdout_lines[0] == 'YES' and len(stdout_lines) == n
postconditions.description: If n is at least 4, the first line is 'YES' and there are exactly n-1 subsequent operation lines.

postconditions.expression: n >= 4 and all(' ' in line and '=' in line and any(op in line for op in ['+', '-', '*']) for line in stdout_lines[1:])
postconditions.description: Each operation line contains spaces, an equals sign, and a valid operator (+, -, or *).
The absolute value of the result of the last operation does not exceed 10^18.
The result of the final operation is exactly 24.

postconditions.expression: n >= 4 and all(eval(line.split('=')[0].strip()) == int(line.split('=')[1].strip()) for line in stdout_lines[1:])
postconditions.description: For every operation line, the arithmetic expression on the left of the equals sign evaluates to the number on the right.
